clips.label: Stumble recovery
clips.prompt: A person walking forward quickly stumbles but maintains their balance

clips.label: Carry and set down
clips.prompt: A person walks forward while carrying a box / A person sets a box down onto the ground

clips.label: Walk and pick up
clips.prompt: A person walking forward picks up something off the ground

clips.label: Diagonal walk and wave
clips.prompt: A person walks diagonally to the left and waves at someone on their right

clips.label: Jog in an arc
clips.prompt: Initially standing still and calm, the person then starts jogging in a counterclockwise arc.

clips.label: Walk with object
clips.prompt: A person is walking while carrying a small object in their left hand

clips.label: Climb stairs
clips.prompt: A person begins walking up the stairs

clips.label: Low-to-high place
clips.prompt: A person picks up an object from low on their left side and places it up high
